## The heuristic

**A change in who contacts us matters as much as a change in how much.**


_Why:_ The named power user disappearing and an unfamiliar junior name appearing means the internal advocate has been reassigned or has given up. Volume can look stable while the person who would have defended the renewal has left the conversation.
